message.takemtitans.welcome: Welcome to Shiganshina, soldier. Your ODM gear is on. Titans roam beyond the outer gate: open it with the winch on the wall, and cut the nape. Supply stations on the wall refill gas and blades.

tooltip.takemtitans.colossal_serum: Throw it. The Colossal Titan's transformation goes off where it lands.
tooltip.takemtitans.colossal_serum_warni: Four seconds. Then everything nearby is gone. Run.
tooltip.takemtitans.rumbling_horn: Blow it. A line of Wall Titans tears out of the ground ahead of you and marches through everything.
tooltip.takemtitans.rumbling_horn_warnin: They don't stop. Not for houses, not for hills, not for the Walls. Not for you.
message.takemtitans.rumbling_subtitle: The Walls have begun to march
message.takemtitans.rumbling_busy: The earth is already shaking. Wait for the march to end.
tooltip.takemtitans.beast_boulder: Throw it to mark a spot. The Beast Titan's barrage of flaming boulders rains down there.
tooltip.takemtitans.beast_boulder_warnin: He throws like a pitcher. Don't stand anywhere near the red smoke.
tooltip.takemtitans.paths_shard: Throw it. A rift to the Paths opens, swallows everything around it, then detonates.
tooltip.takemtitans.paths_shard_warning: What goes in comes back out. All at once.
tooltip.takemtitans.godspeed: Afterburners. Break the sound barrier and everything near you feels it.
tooltip.takemtitans.phantom_gear: Ghost-steel rig. Faster than Advanced, quieter than a breath.
tooltip.takemtitans.phase_dash: Phase Dash: every dash slips you out of the world for a heartbeat. Nothing can touch you, and you leave afterimages behind.
tooltip.takemtitans.event_horizon_gear: It doesn't fly through space. It folds it.
tooltip.takemtitans.event_horizon_gear.j: Hyperspace Jump: boost + dash to tear through up to 28 blocks of space. Titans in the way are cut, everything at the far end is thrown back.
tooltip.takemtitans.titanbreaker: Tap attack to fire a slash wave that cuts titans and buildings in half.
tooltip.takemtitans.blades_tier.titanbre: Titanbreaker steel: forged for gods, cuts through anything
quest.takemtitans.chapter.ch5: Chapter 5: The Beast of the Hills
quest.takemtitans.report.obj: Report to Commander Varne in the plaza
quest.takemtitans.wings.obj: Bring down titans outside the gate (%s/%s)
quest.takemtitans.mira.obj: Find Scout Mira Holt in the forest
quest.takemtitans.trost.obj: Ride north to the Trost district
quest.takemtitans.hale.obj: Report to Captain Hale in the Trost plaza
quest.takemtitans.armored.obj: Stop the Armored Titan outside Shiganshina
quest.takemtitans.beast.obj: Hunt the Beast Titan in the south-eastern hills
quest.takemtitans.contracts.obj: Ask Commander Varne for a contract
dialogue.takemtitans.report.0: So you're %s. The academy says you fly like you have nothing to lose. Good. Out here, that's the only kind that lasts.
dialogue.takemtitans.report.1: Year 912. A hundred years of quiet behind these walls, and in the last month the titans outside have tripled. They aren't wandering. They're waiting.
dialogue.takemtitans.report.2: I don't have time to train you the slow way. Bram, our quartermaster by the inner gate, will keep you in gas and steel if you bring him Merit Badges. Every titan you drop earns some.
dialogue.takemtitans.report.3: Your first order is simple. Go out through the south gate and bring down two titans. Aim for the nape: a hand wide, a forearm deep. Anything else just makes them angry.
dialogue.takemtitans.report.4: Come back alive and you'll have earned your wings. Come back dead and I'll write the academy a very unpleasant letter.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief.0: Two kills and still breathing. The lookouts on the wall were taking bets on you. I won.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief.1: Now the bad news. Scout Mira Holt rode into the Giant Forest four days ago to find out why the titans are gathering. Her flare went up yesterday. Green, then nothing.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief.2: Nobody comes out of that forest by luck. I'm sending you because you're fast, and because everyone else I trust is holding this wall.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief.3: The forest lies south-west of the gate. Follow the gold beam. Find her, %s.
dialogue.takemtitans.mira.0: You're the rescue? Varne must be desperate. Thanks for the cut on that last one, by the way. My blades were down to the hilts.
dialogue.takemtitans.mira.1: Listen, because I'm only saying this once. The titans aren't gathering on their own. Something is calling them. A roar from the east every dusk, and they all turn their heads at once.
dialogue.takemtitans.mira.2: I followed the sound. I saw a titan covered in fur, taller than the rest, and it was watching me. Not like an animal. Like a man reading a map.
dialogue.takemtitans.mira.3: There's worse. Trost sent riders for help two days ago. If the titans are being herded, they're being herded north. Towards Trost.
dialogue.takemtitans.mira.4: Veteran steel is sold at the quartermaster now, and you've earned the badges for it. Get to Trost. I'll report to Varne and catch up. Go, %s!
dialogue.takemtitans.hale.0: Survey Corps? The one time I'm glad to see wings on a cloak. Captain Roderick Hale, Trost garrison. What's left of it.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale.1: They came through a crack in the outer wall at dawn. Not a breach, a crack. Something hit that wall from outside, hard, three times, and then they poured in.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale.2: My lookouts saw it before they ran. A titan with skin like white stone. Cannon shot bounced off it. Afterwards it walked away south, calm as anything, towards Shiganshina.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale.3: If it does to your gate what it did to mine, Shiganshina falls by nightfall. Blades will only chip it. Thunder spears, a dive from height, anything with real weight behind it.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale.4: I'll send word to your commander. Get back to Shiganshina and meet it outside the gate, %s. Don't let it reach the wall.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief2.0: I watched that from the wall. Half the garrison was cheering and the other half was praying. I was doing both.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief2.1: A titan that throws, a titan in armor, and both of them thinking. These aren't wild titans, %s. Someone is aiming them at us.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief2.2: Mira tracked the roar. It comes from the hills south-east of Shiganshina, where the old watchtowers burned down.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief2.3: The fur-covered one is there. It calls the others and throws rocks the way our cannons wish they could. If it lives, we face another siege within the week.
dialogue.takemtitans.debrief2.4: End it. Take every spear you can carry. And %s... come back. I've grown used to you.
dialogue.takemtitans.dawn.0: It's over. The roar stopped the moment it fell. The titans outside are wandering again, like they've forgotten why they came.
dialogue.takemtitans.dawn.1: Mira found something where it died. A soldier's tag, very old, from before the walls. Whoever was inside that titan was one of us, once.
dialogue.takemtitans.dawn.2: That's a question for another day. Today the walls are standing and Trost is ours again. Hale sends his thanks, and a cask of something I won't let you drink.
dialogue.takemtitans.dawn.3: I'm putting your name forward for a captaincy, %s. Don't argue. The paperwork alone will be punishment enough.
dialogue.takemtitans.dawn.4: Titans will always roam out there. Come to me whenever you want work: I'll have garrison contracts, and every one pays in badges.
dialogue.takemtitans.dawn.5: Now come. Watch the sun rise over Wall Maria with me. We earned this one.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.0: Morning, soldier. Bread's still warm at the bakery, if you're quick.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.1: My husband says the titans can't climb. I say the walls are only fifty meters tall.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.2: Are you one of those Survey Corps lunatics? Bless you. Truly. Now please go away from my door.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.3: The bells rang twice last night. Nobody will tell me why.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.4: My boy wants to join the Scouts. I hid his boots.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.5: Hundred years of peace, and still I check the gate every morning.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.6: If you see a titan with a beard, tell it my brother owes me money.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.7: Watch your step, %s. The cobbles on this street are older than the wall.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.8: Garrison drinks more than it guards, if you ask me. Not you, though. You look sober. Mostly.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.civilian.9: When the gas whistle goes over the roofs, the children run outside to wave. Fly low for them sometime.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.0: Stay sharp, %s. The count outside doubled since yesterday.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.1: Cannons are loaded, but between you and me, I've never seen one stop a titan.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.2: Bram gave me a full canister for two badges. Best trade of my life.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.3: They say a good cut feels like nothing. A bad cut, you feel all week.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.4: If one grabs you, cut the thumb. Always the thumb.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.5: I've been on wall duty for six years. Never once looked down. Not planning to start.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.6: Fly fast, cut deep, don't look at the faces. That's all the academy really teaches.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.soldier.7: The commander rarely smiles. She smiled after your last mission. Don't let it go to your head.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.commander.0: Keep your gas topped up, %s. A soldier without gas is a meal.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.commander.1: I read every report. Yours are the only ones I enjoy.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.commander.2: Walls don't keep us safe. People do. Remember that.
Badges for steel, steel for titans, titans for badges. The circle of life, %s.
Don't ask what the Godspeed rig costs. Then again, you've got the badges for it, don't you?
Bring the blades back in one piece once in a while. Just once. For my heart.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.mira.0: Still alive? Good. I don't like breaking in new partners.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.mira.1: That forest still gives me nightmares. Trees taller than the wall, and things moving between them.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.mira.2: Race you to the top of the church tower, %s. Loser buys dinner.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.hale.0: Trost is rebuilding. Slowly. The bakers came back first, which says a lot about this town.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.hale.1: I owe you a drink, %s. Several. The commander says no.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.hale.2: We patched the crack in the outer wall with three hundred tons of stone. I still hear it at night.
dialogue.takemtitans.hint.commander: Commander Varne is looking for you. She's in the plaza.
dialogue.takemtitans.hint.mira: Someone said Scout Mira Holt went into the Giant Forest and never came out.
dialogue.takemtitans.hint.hale: Captain Hale is holding the Trost plaza, north of here.
dialogue.takemtitans.contract.new.0: Back for more, %s? Good. The lookouts have a job for you.
dialogue.takemtitans.contract.new.1: There's always work out there. Here's today's.
dialogue.takemtitans.contract.new.2: The garrison is stretched thin again. I need your blades, %s.
contract.takemtitans.kind.3: Bring down titans of 12 m or more (%s/%s)
message.takemtitans.armor_broken: The Armored Titan's plates shatter! Go for the nape!
cutscene.takemtitans.intro.1: For a hundred years, three walls have kept humanity safe.
cutscene.takemtitans.intro.2: Shiganshina sits at the very edge of that safety, a town built where the world ends.
cutscene.takemtitans.intro.3: This morning, the titans outside have stopped wandering.
cutscene.takemtitans.trost.0: Trost. The outer wall is cracked, and the streets are full of titans.
cutscene.takemtitans.trost.1: The garrison is falling back to the plaza.
cutscene.takemtitans.armored.0: Its skin is white stone. Cannon fire just bounces off.
cutscene.takemtitans.armored.1: Blades only chip the plates. Break them with thunder spears or a Meteor Dive, then go for the nape!
cutscene.takemtitans.beast.0: A titan covered in fur, and it's looking straight at you.
cutscene.takemtitans.beast.1: It throws boulders and roars for others. Close the distance fast!
cutscene.takemtitans.finale.1: Trost is retaken. The walls are standing.
cutscene.takemtitans.finale.2: Whoever sent those titans is still out there, somewhere beyond the walls.
cutscene.takemtitans.finale.3: But this morning, the sun rises on humanity.
skill.takemtitans.title: Skill Tree
message.takemtitans.nova_locked: Unlock Gas Nova in the skill tree (G).
message.takemtitans.rip_too_solid: That wall is too dense to rip.
message.takemtitans.wings: Wings of Freedom — fall damage negated.
tooltip.takemtitans.vanguard: Full Vanguard kit + ODM gear grants combat perks.
tooltip.takemtitans.thermobaric: Fuel-air burst — clears rooms and titans alike.
cutscene.takemtitans.falling.0: Mitras shakes. Whole districts peel away and fall.
cutscene.takemtitans.falling.1: Hook the falling mass to ride it down, or hold Shift as your hook hits to catch it.
cutscene.takemtitans.falling.2: Hold the line until the sky stops raining stone.
cutscene.takemtitans.ravager.0: Something enormous moves through the breach — all teeth and fury.
cutscene.takemtitans.ravager.1: Bring it down before Mitras is erased.
cutscene.takemtitans.epilogue.0: The Ravager is dead. Mitras still stands, barely.
cutscene.takemtitans.epilogue.1: Scouts cheer from the walls. Civilians weep in the rubble.
cutscene.takemtitans.epilogue.2: Your name is already legend — but the titans beyond the walls remain.
skill.takemtitans.nape_specialist.desc: +12% damage to the nape per rank.
skill.takemtitans.flowing_combo.desc: Your combo lasts 1.5 s longer and climbs 2 steps higher per rank.
skill.takemtitans.thunder_execution.desc: A rush attack (hold attack in the air) that hits the nape deals 2.5x damage and calls down lightning.
skill.takemtitans.crescent_cyclone.desc: Your spin attack (dash, then dash again) throws a ring of crescent slash waves around you.
skill.takemtitans.ackerman_awakening.des: Overdrive triggers at a 6-hit combo instead of 10 and lasts 20 s. Nape kills in Overdrive release a blast wave.
skill.takemtitans.reinforced_winch.desc: +15% reel speed and +50% lifting power per rank.
skill.takemtitans.afterburn_dash.desc: +15% dash power and 20% shorter dash cooldown per rank.
skill.takemtitans.wrecking_ball.desc: Lift chunks three times heavier. Thrown chunks hit harder and smash bigger holes.
skill.takemtitans.phantom_step.desc: A nape kill resets your dash, spin and rush cooldowns and refills 150 gas.
skill.takemtitans.titan_winch.desc: Lift any falling chunk, however big. Shift + reel on a wall to tear a chunk out of it.
skill.takemtitans.heavy_landing.desc: +15% Meteor Dive power per rank. (Meteor Dive: look down in the air, hold attack and press dash. Recharges in 7 s.)
skill.takemtitans.shockwave.desc: The Meteor Dive shock front reaches 35% further and hits 25% harder per rank.
skill.takemtitans.demolisher.desc: +20% crater size and building destruction per rank, for dives and explosions.
skill.takemtitans.meteor_rebound.desc: After a Meteor Dive you bounce back into the sky. Chain up to 3 dives, each 35% stronger than the last.
skill.takemtitans.comet_trail.desc: +20% Meteor Dive power, and the dive burns and damages everything you pass on the way down.
skill.takemtitans.extinction_event.desc: Your dives become extinction-level: 25% bigger blasts, deeper craters, and titans caught in the core die instantly.
skill.takemtitans.gas_nova.desc: Press G to dump gas into an explosive nova around you.
skill.takemtitans.volatile_mix.desc: Gas Nova: +2.5 blocks radius, +30% damage per rank.
skill.takemtitans.spear_specialist.desc: Thunder spears detonate faster, blast wider, rip chunks out of buildings and deal extra damage to titans. Rank 2 sets the blast on fire.
skill.takemtitans.chain_reaction.desc: Your Gas Nova sets off a ring of secondary explosions.
skill.takemtitans.incendiary_edge.desc: Every 4th combo hit explodes in fire on the titan.
skill.takemtitans.supernova.desc: With 60%+ gas, Gas Nova becomes a Supernova: a huge fireball that levels the street around you.
skill.takemtitans.iron_will.desc: +2 hearts of maximum health per rank.
skill.takemtitans.squad_leader.desc: Command more Jaegers: 2 more at rank 1, 4 more at rank 2 (2 can always be hired at any quartermaster).
skill.takemtitans.field_medic.desc: Regenerate health over time. Faster with each rank.
skill.takemtitans.rally_cry.desc: Nape kills rally everyone nearby: +15% blade damage for 10 s, and the town's soldiers take heart.
skill.takemtitans.veteran_instincts.desc: When a titan grabs you, you cut yourself free automatically (once every 30 s).
skill.takemtitans.wings_of_freedom.desc: Once every 5 minutes, a killing blow fails: you survive at 40% health and enter Overdrive.
dialogue.takemtitans.vanguard.0: Captain %s. It has a ring to it, doesn't it? Don't get comfortable. The Beast was not the end of this.
dialogue.takemtitans.vanguard.1: Our scouts found tracks outside Wall Rose. Big ones. Bigger than anything we've buried. And they lead north, towards the capital.
dialogue.takemtitans.vanguard.2: So I'm forming a Vanguard. The best flyers left in the Corps, under your command. They'll die for you if you let them. Don't let them.
dialogue.takemtitans.vanguard.3: The quartermaster has the Vanguard kit on his shelf for you now. Reinforced coat, steel-capped boots, a helmet that actually stops rubble. Wear all of it with your gear and you'll land like a cat.
dialogue.takemtitans.vanguard.4: Jaegers patrol the districts. Talk to them and recruit the ones you trust. The Squad Leader skill (press K) decides how many will follow you.
dialogue.takemtitans.vanguard.5: Take your squad outside and prove you can bring them home. Six titans, every soldier alive. That's the test.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale2.0: %s! Good timing. Trost has been quiet for weeks, and I hate quiet. Quiet means something is coming.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale2.1: The supply wagon from the capital never arrived. The driver's horse came back alone, covered in plaster dust. Mitras dust.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale2.2: The Military Police swear everything is fine behind Wall Sina. The Military Police also swore titans couldn't break Trost.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale2.3: Take these: cluster spears, fresh from the workshop. One spear, a dozen charges. Point it at anything big and pray you're far enough away.
dialogue.takemtitans.hale2.4: Ride north, through the Rose gate, to the capital. If Mitras falls, there is nowhere left to run.
dialogue.takemtitans.epilogue.0: You're alive. Every bell in Mitras is ringing, and half of them are lying in the street.
dialogue.takemtitans.epilogue.1: The Ravager came from the same place the Beast did. Mira is sure of it. Same old tags, same rotten smell of the underground.
dialogue.takemtitans.epilogue.2: The King gave a speech. Nobody listened. The crowd was chanting your name the whole time, %s. I've never seen nobles that pale.
dialogue.takemtitans.epilogue.3: The Vanguard stays. Your squad stays. Whatever is sending these monsters, we will find it, and we will cut its nape.
dialogue.takemtitans.epilogue.4: Until then: the contracts are waiting, the walls need patrolling, and the children of Trost want to see someone fly. Give them a show.
dialogue.takemtitans.epilogue.5: Dedicate your heart, Captain. And thank you.
quest.takemtitans.vanguard.obj: Report to Commander Varne for a new assignment
quest.takemtitans.squad_hunt.obj: Bring down titans with your Vanguard (%s/%s)
quest.takemtitans.hale2.obj: Meet Captain Hale in the Trost plaza
quest.takemtitans.mitras.obj: Ride north to Mitras, the capital behind Wall Sina
quest.takemtitans.falling_sky.obj: Catch falling sections: Shift as your hook hits (%s/%s)
quest.takemtitans.ravager.obj: Kill the Ravager Titan before it reaches the capital
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.squad.1: Gas is full, blades are sharp. Where to?
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.squad.2: Still breathing, Captain. Thanks to you.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.squad.3: Say the word and we fly.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.squad.4: I counted your kills yesterday. I stopped at twenty.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.idle.0: You're %s, aren't you? Everyone talks about you.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.idle.2: My squad leader went over the wall last month. Didn't come back.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.idle.3: I trained on the same rigs as you. You were faster.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.idle.4: If you ever need another blade, I'm here.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.idle.5: I want to see what's beyond the walls before I die.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.full: Your squad is full (%s). Train the Squad Leader skill to command more Jaegers.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.no_skill: You need the Squad Leader skill (Leadership branch, press K) to recruit Jaegers.
dialogue.takemtitans.jaeger.taken: Sorry, I already serve another captain.
skill.takemtitans.msg.open: Press K to open the skill tree
tooltip.takemtitans.cluster_spear: Splits mid-flight into a swarm of bomblets. Carpet-bombs a whole street.
tooltip.takemtitans.demolition_charge: Sticks where it lands and goes off a few seconds later. Brings whole houses down.
shout.takemtitans.panic.6: Don't look at it, just run!
shout.takemtitans.soldier.6: Don't let it reach the plaza!
shout.takemtitans.night.1: Hear that? Steps outside the wall...
shout.takemtitans.chatter.3: Have you heard about the Scouts?
shout.takemtitans.chatter.9: The bells rang again last night.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_call.0: Rest is over, %s. Signal flares went up over Wall Rose last night: red, then black. Both from the east.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_call.1: Karanes. A walled district bulging out of Rose, like Trost. Fifteen thousand people, one garrison, and as of last night no messenger has come back.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_call.2: And Krolva in the west has gone silent too. Whatever came out of the ground under Mitras did not come alone.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_call.3: Take your Vanguard and these spears. Fly east to Karanes first. Then Krolva. Then we see what the Military Police are hiding in Stohess.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_call.4: Four districts, one Corps. If anyone can hold them all, it's you.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_report.0: Karanes holds. Krolva is half rubble, but its people are alive, and they're already singing songs about a meteor that fell on a titan.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_report.1: And Stohess... The MPs had a pit under their barracks, %s. Old tunnels, older than the walls. That's where they came from. All of them.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_report.2: The King has finally signed the order: every district gets a Survey Corps garrison. Your squad will train them.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_report.3: You've seen every wall now. Shiganshina, Trost, Karanes, Krolva, Stohess, Ehrmich, Mitras. There is nobody left inside these walls who hasn't heard your name.
dialogue.takemtitans.outer_report.4: The tunnels still go somewhere. When we're ready, we follow them. Until then: contracts, patrols, and try to sleep once in a while.
quest.takemtitans.outer_call.obj: Report to Commander Varne: flares over Wall Rose
quest.takemtitans.karanes.obj: Fly east to the Karanes District on Wall Rose
quest.takemtitans.karanes_siege.obj: Break the siege of Karanes (%s/%s titans)
quest.takemtitans.krolva_fall.obj: Krolva is collapsing: catch falling sections with Shift + hook (%s/%s)
quest.takemtitans.stohess_hunt.obj: Hunt the titans in the Stohess District, east of Mitras (%s/%s)
quest.takemtitans.outer_report.obj: Report back to Commander Varne in Shiganshina
cutscene.takemtitans.karanes.0: Karanes. Smoke over every roof, and the bells won't stop.
cutscene.takemtitans.karanes.1: Titans are already inside the district wall.
cutscene.takemtitans.krolva.0: Krolva, the western district. The ground under it is hollow.
cutscene.takemtitans.krolva.1: Whole buildings are sliding into the dark.
cutscene.takemtitans.krolva.2: Hold Shift as your hook hits to catch the falling sections!
skill.takemtitans.skyfall_strike.desc: Blade hits while you fall deal +15% damage per rank, doubled when you fall really fast. Drop onto them from above.
skill.takemtitans.kill_chain.desc: Each nape kill within 8 s of the last adds a chain link (max 5): +15% blade damage per link, +25% at rank 2.
skill.takemtitans.aftershock.desc: After a Meteor Dive your blades stay charged: the next 3 hits (5 at rank 2) on a titan explode in lightning.
skill.takemtitans.executioner.desc: Nape hits on a titan whose nape is below 35% deal double damage.
skill.takemtitans.storm_dash.desc: Every gas dash bursts into a shock wave that flings people and debris away and staggers nearby titans.
skill.takemtitans.skybreaker.desc: Combo finisher: a nape kill at a 15+ combo calls lightning down on every titan within 28 blocks and burns their napes.
tooltip.takemtitans.cannon_1: Tier 1: fires solid iron shot. Upgrade with 4 Ultrahard Steel.
tooltip.takemtitans.cannon_2: Tier 2: heavy explosive shells that blow out walls. Upgrade with 2 Titan Heart Shards.
tooltip.takemtitans.cannon_3: Tier 3: three thunder shells at once, with lightning.
tooltip.takemtitans.cannon_use: Right click to man it, left click to fire, sneak to leave. Sneak + right click with an empty hand: crew on/off.
message.takemtitans.wall_sealed: The nape is sealed! Destroy the glowing cores first (%s left)
message.takemtitans.wall_exposed: THE NAPE IS OPEN! Cut it now!
message.takemtitans.cannon_crew_on: Garrison crew assigned: the cannon fires at titans on its own
message.takemtitans.cannon_manned: Cannon manned: aim with your view, left click to fire, sneak to leave
quest.takemtitans.tunnels_call.obj: Report to Commander Varne about the pit under Stohess
quest.takemtitans.tunnels.obj: Go to the pit in the Stohess market square
quest.takemtitans.tunnel_purge.obj: Clear the tunnels under Stohess (%s/%s titans)
quest.takemtitans.hearts.obj: Destroy the Titan Hearts in the deepest cavern (%s/%s)
quest.takemtitans.wall_titan.obj: Bring down the Wall Titan: destroy its 4 cores, then cut the nape
dialogue.takemtitans.tunnels_call.0: %s. The Military Police finally let Mira into their barracks pit in Stohess. She came back up white as chalk.
dialogue.takemtitans.tunnels_call.1: Under the market square there's a shaft, and under the shaft there are tunnels. Miles of them. Older than the walls, older than the Kings.
dialogue.takemtitans.tunnels_call.2: And something is growing down there. Mira says the walls of the deepest cavern beat. Like a heart. Several hearts.
dialogue.takemtitans.tunnels_call.3: That is where the titans come from. All of them: Trost, Karanes, the Ravager. We have been fighting the crop and never found the field.
dialogue.takemtitans.tunnels_call.4: Take spears, charges, all the gas you can carry. Go down, find those hearts and cut them out. The galleries are wide enough to fly, barely.
dialogue.takemtitans.finale2.0: You rode a Wall Titan down, %s. I watched it from the gate. I'm still not sure I believe it.
dialogue.takemtitans.finale2.1: The hearts were keeping the ones in the Walls asleep. Kill the hearts and they wake. That's what Mira thinks. That one woke angry.
dialogue.takemtitans.finale2.2: We counted the ones still sleeping in Wall Sina alone: hundreds. Thousands in Rose and Maria. Every wall we ever trusted is full of them.
dialogue.takemtitans.finale2.3: The Garrison is mounting cannons on every district wall. Thunder batteries in Stohess, siege guns in Trost. If they wake, we'll be ready.
dialogue.takemtitans.finale2.4: As for you: Commander of the Vanguard. No arguing. Pick your own officers. Train them the way you fly.
dialogue.takemtitans.finale2.5: And then, one day, we go beyond the walls and find out who built them. Dedicate your heart, Commander.
cutscene.takemtitans.tunnels.0: The deepest cavern. The walls are alive.
cutscene.takemtitans.tunnels.1: Three hearts beat in the dark, and with every beat a titan crawls out.
cutscene.takemtitans.tunnels.2: Cut them out. Spears and charges hit hardest.
cutscene.takemtitans.wall_titan.0: Wall Sina cracks open from the inside.
cutscene.takemtitans.wall_titan.1: Fifty-eight metres of stone-skinned titan steps out of the wall.
cutscene.takemtitans.wall_titan.2: Climb it. Break its four glowing cores. Then the nape.
message.takemtitans.chamber_collapse: The chamber is collapsing! Hang on to the falling slabs or get out!
message.takemtitans.district_saved: %s held: only %s blocks lost. The Garrison pays %s Merit Badges for every house you saved.
message.takemtitans.district_ruined: %s took heavy damage (%s blocks lost). No bonus this time: protect the town and it pays.
hud.takemtitans.town_paused: Rebuilding paused: titans in the district!
shop.takemtitans.title: Quartermaster's Counter
tooltip.takemtitans.merit_badge: Goes straight into your wallet: spend it at any Quartermaster.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.builder.0: Stand back, %s, this wall's still settling.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.builder.1: Every brick back where it was. My grandfather built this street, I'm not getting it wrong.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.builder.2: You lot knock them down, we put them back up. Fair trade. Mostly.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.builder.3: Try to keep the fighting off the rooftops next time, would you? Rooftops are the worst.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.builder.4: Give us a day or two and you won't know anything happened.
shout.takemtitans.builder.2: Plumb line! Who took the plumb line?
shout.takemtitans.builder.6: We'll have it standing by tomorrow!
shout.takemtitans.builder_start.0: Right, lads, let's get to work!
shout.takemtitans.builder_start.2: What a mess. Let's fix it.
shout.takemtitans.builder_done.1: Done! Drinks are on the Garrison!
shout.takemtitans.builder_done.3: Better than before, if you ask me.
shout.takemtitans.greet.2: Is that the one who killed the Armored Titan?
shout.takemtitans.greet.4: My son wants to be just like you.
tooltip.takemtitans.med_kit: Heals 6 hearts, then regeneration and extra absorption hearts. 15 s cooldown.
tooltip.takemtitans.whetstone: Puts a fresh edge on the most worn blades you carry. 8 uses.
tooltip.takemtitans.adrenaline: Ackerman Overdrive on demand, plus speed and strength. 1 min cooldown.
tooltip.takemtitans.squad_horn: Calls every Jaeger of your squad to your side, healed and fast.
tooltip.takemtitans.smoke_bomb: Throw it: a thick cloud that blinds every titan inside for 8 seconds.
tooltip.takemtitans.net_launcher: Fires a weighted steel net: a titan it hits goes down for 11 seconds. 16 shots.
message.takemtitans.horn: The horn sounds: %s Jaegers on their way
skill.takemtitans.blade_dancer.desc: Mastery. +20% blade damage, and every nape kill heals you for 1.5 hearts.
skill.takemtitans.sky_lord.desc: Mastery. 30% less gas for everything and 30% shorter dash cooldown.
skill.takemtitans.cataclysm.desc: Mastery. Meteor Dives hit 25% harder and recharge twice as fast.
skill.takemtitans.inferno.desc: Mastery. Every explosion you cause is 20% bigger and 25% deadlier; Gas Nova recharges twice as fast.
skill.takemtitans.legion.desc: Mastery. Room for 2 more Jaegers, your Jaegers hit 30% harder and level up twice as fast.
skill.takemtitans.godslayer.desc: Mastery. +25% nape damage, and Skybreaker triggers from a 10-hit combo.
message.takemtitans.district_fallen: %s HAS FALLEN. Nothing is left standing; the people are gone. It can be rebuilt from the ground up at any quartermaster, for %s Merit Badges.
message.takemtitans.district_reborn: %s paid to rebuild %s. The engineers are on their way back.
message.takemtitans.fortified: %s fortified to level %s: reinforced masonry and faster repairs.
hud.takemtitans.town_fallen: FALLEN: rebuild for %s badges at a quartermaster
raid.takemtitans.start_sub: Ring the bells. Man the cannons. Hold the district: %s waves are coming.
raid.takemtitans.wave_sub: %s titans are coming over the wall
raid.takemtitans.next_wave: Resupply. The next wave is coming.
raid.takemtitans.boss_sub: Rock-hard skin, jaws that bite through anything. Only the nape is soft.
raid.takemtitans.won_sub: +%s Merit Badges, 800 XP  ·  %s%% of the district destroyed
raid.takemtitans.lost_sub: The district has fallen. Rebuild it at a quartermaster.
raid.takemtitans.hud_warning: Titans sighted! First wave in %s s
streak.takemtitans.sub: %s titans in a row  ·  bonus Merit Badges
tooltip.takemtitans.horse_whistle: Calls your scout horse from anywhere. It charges faster the longer it runs, marks nearby titans and ignores falls. Fire your hooks from the saddle to launch off its back.
message.takemtitans.horse_coming: Your horse is on its way.
message.takemtitans.horse_new: A fresh horse gallops out of the stables for you.
message.takemtitans.horse_wait: The stables need %s more seconds to saddle a new horse.
message.takemtitans.horse_fallen: Your horse has fallen. The stables will send you another one soon.
shop.takemtitans.locked: Not for sale yet: unlocks in %s.
message.takemtitans.welcome_recruit: Welcome to Shiganshina, recruit. Nobody faces a titan without training: report to Instructor Brandt at the Training Corps yard, a short walk east along this street. The marker in the top left shows the way.
training.takemtitans.welcome.sub: Report to Instructor Brandt at the training yard
training.takemtitans.call: Over here, recruit! Don't keep me waiting.
training.takemtitans.call_back: Back to me, recruit. Let's hear it.
training.takemtitans.graduated.sub: You're a soldier now. Report to Commander Varne in the plaza.
training.takemtitans.too_slow: Too slow: the pad held (%s%%). Build speed with gas, then cut.
training.takemtitans.name.reel: Reel in: climb to the beams
training.takemtitans.obj.reel: Hold %3$s or %4$s to reel up to the beams
training.takemtitans.obj.spin: In the air: tap %6$s twice to spin
training.takemtitans.obj.cut: Cut a dummy's nape at speed %7$s (%1$s/%2$s)
training.takemtitans.obj.rush: Hold %7$s, then let go: Blade Rush
training.takemtitans.say.hook: Drill one: hooks. Aim at the gantry beams and fire the left hook with %1$s, the right one with %2$s. Anchor three times.
training.takemtitans.say.reel: Drill two: hold %1$s or %2$s to wind the wire in and let it pull you up. Get yourself up level with the beams.
training.takemtitans.say.gas: Drill three: gas. In the air, %3$s gives you a boost and %4$s a hard dash where you look. Four bursts. Don't waste the tank.
training.takemtitans.say.spin: Drill four: the spin. In the air, dash with %4$s and tap %4$s again right after: you spin and cut everything around you. Reel in while you do it and it becomes a cyclone.
training.takemtitans.say.cut: Drill five: the cut. Those two wooden titans wear a leather pad on the nape. Come in fast from behind and above and swing %5$s as you pass. Hacking from a standstill won't get through, only speed cuts. Two clean cuts.
training.takemtitans.say.rush: Drill six: Blade Rush. Hold %5$s to charge your blades, then let go: you shoot forward and cut through whatever is in your way.
training.takemtitans.say.reload: Drill seven: those blades are dull now. Press %6$s to snap a fresh pair out of your gear. Learn to do it mid-air without thinking.
training.takemtitans.say.supply: Drill eight: your tanks are low. Use the supply station in my shed with %7$s to refill gas and blades. Every wall and outpost has one.
training.takemtitans.say.graduate: That's all eight. Come back to me, recruit.
training.takemtitans.say.farewell: Dismissed, soldier. Make the Training Corps proud.
training.takemtitans.say.skipped: Fine. Show the Commander what you can do, and don't come crying back to me.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.report.0: So you're the new recruit, %s. I'm Brandt. I've turned farmers, bakers and pickpockets into soldiers, and I'll do the same with you.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.report.1: Out there a titan dies one way only: a deep cut across the nape of the neck. Arms, legs, eyes, it all grows back.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.report.2: To reach a nape fifteen metres up you need your ODM gear. Hooks to anchor, gas to fly, blades to cut.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.report.3: Strap it on. Eight drills, then you're a soldier.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.reissue: Where's your gear, recruit? Here, a spare set. Don't lose this one.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.first: Not yet, %s. Instructor Brandt signs off every recruit first. The training yard is just east of the arrival street.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.graduate.0: Not bad, %s. Not bad at all. Most recruits need a week to get that far.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.graduate.1: From here on there are no wooden dummies. Commander Varne takes in new soldiers at the plaza. Report to her.
dialogue.takemtitans.training.graduate.2: Take the rest of your kit: flare gun, thunder spears, spare blades, gas and bread. Speed first, then the cut. Always.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.instructor.0: Speed is everything, %s. A slow cut is a wasted blade.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.instructor.1: The dummies don't bite. The real ones do. Practise while you can.
dialogue.takemtitans.idle.instructor.2: Watch your gas. Recruits who run dry don't come back.
adventure.takemtitans.title: Takém Titans
adventure.takemtitans.tagline: Shiganshina. Three walls. One hundred years of peace.
adventure.takemtitans.new.sub: A new recruit reports to the Training Corps.
adventure.takemtitans.keep_info: You keep your gear when you die. Change it any time with /gamerule keepInventory.
adventure.takemtitans.hardcore_info: Hardcore: one life. The titans don't give second chances.
tooltip.takemtitans.blades_tier.serrated: Serrated steel: saw teeth cut from the Armored Titan's hide
tooltip.takemtitans.blades_tier.founder: Founder's steel: forged in the Paths, it answers to no titan
tooltip.takemtitans.serrated: Limb cuts bite 80% deeper: arms come off and titans drop far sooner.
tooltip.takemtitans.founder: Tap attack to throw a fan of three slash waves.
tooltip.takemtitans.founder2: Nape kills call lightning down on every titan nearby, and it echoes.
tooltip.takemtitans.recon: Full Recon set: 25% less gas, falls hurt 60% less.
tooltip.takemtitans.hardened: Full Hardened set: titan blows deal 40% less, and near death the crystal bursts to save you.
message.takemtitans.horse_unlocked.sub: Use the Horse Whistle to call it
message.takemtitans.horse_unlocked.chat: You've earned a Survey Corps horse. Blow the Horse Whistle and it gallops to you from anywhere. Ride it long and straight and it builds into a full charge, much faster than any horse. It smells titans and marks every one nearby for you, never gets hurt by falls, and takes only half the damage from titan blows. Fire your hooks from the saddle to launch off its back.
manual.takemtitans.title: Field Manual
manual.takemtitans.subtitle: Survey Corps - for soldiers' eyes only
manual.takemtitans.hint: ←/→ or mouse wheel: turn pages  ·  ↑/↓: chapters  ·  Esc: close
manual.takemtitans.start.title: First Steps
manual.takemtitans.start.0.title: Welcome, Recruit
manual.takemtitans.start.0.body:
You arrive in Shiganshina with nothing but the clothes on your back. Commander Varne waits on the square: a golden beam and a "!" mark whoever has work for you.

Instructor Brandt drills you on the training yard first: eight exercises against wooden titans. Pass them and you get your full kit and your first mission.
manual.takemtitans.start.1.title: Badges & the Quartermaster
manual.takemtitans.start.1.body:
Merit badges pay for everything: story missions, every titan you kill, kill streaks, raids you repel and contracts.

Every district has a quartermaster stall (look for the hologram). New gear unlocks there as the story moves on. The big pieces are expensive on purpose: save up.

This manual opens with [MANUAL] at any time.
manual.takemtitans.odm.title: ODM Gear
manual.takemtitans.odm.0.title: Hooks & Cables
manual.takemtitans.odm.0.body:
[L] and [R] fire the left and right hook. Hold to reel in, let go to release. With blades in hand, [USE] fires both at once.

Hold [WINCH] to lock the winch: you swing like a pendulum instead of reeling in. Hooks bite into walls, titans and falling chunks of buildings alike.
manual.takemtitans.odm.1.title: Gas & Speed
manual.takemtitans.odm.1.body:
[BOOST] in the air fires the gas thrusters. [DASH] is a short burst in the direction you steer.

Gas runs out: refill at supply stations or with gas canisters. [RELOAD] snaps a fresh pair of blades out of the boxes.

Momentum is everything: a swing keeps its speed, and speed is damage.
manual.takemtitans.combat.title: Combat
manual.takemtitans.combat.0.title: Only the Nape Kills
manual.takemtitans.combat.0.body:
Titans heal from everything else. Hit the nape, as fast as you can.

A gold diamond around the crosshair means your blades line up with a nape. Aim close to a nape and your hook locks onto it (the sights turn gold).

Cutting legs, tendons and eyes slows a titan down and buys your squad time.
manual.takemtitans.combat.1.title: Manoeuvres
manual.takemtitans.combat.1.body:
Hold [ATTACK] to charge a Blade Rush, release to launch through everything in front of you.

[DASH] twice in quick succession: a spinning slash (a drill while reeling).

From high up, look down, hold [ATTACK] and press [DASH]: Meteor Dive.

[NOVA]: Gas Nova (once learned). Ten hits in a combo: Overdrive.
manual.takemtitans.gear.title: Equipment
manual.takemtitans.gear.0.title: The Gear Ladder
manual.takemtitans.gear.0.body:
Standard → Advanced (Trost) → Phantom (the Vanguard) → Godspeed (Mitras) → Event Horizon (the tunnels).

Each step carries more gas and reels, boosts and dashes harder, with a higher top speed.
manual.takemtitans.gear.1.title: Rigs With a Secret
manual.takemtitans.gear.1.body:
Phantom: every [DASH] phases you out of the world for a heartbeat. Nothing can touch you, and you leave afterimages behind.

Godspeed: afterburners. At full speed you break the sound barrier and the boom hurts everything around you.

Event Horizon: all of the above, plus the Hyperspace Jump: [BOOST] + [DASH] tears you up to 28 blocks along your line of sight.
manual.takemtitans.gear.2.title: Blades
manual.takemtitans.gear.2.body:
Standard, Veteran, Serrated, Ackerman, Titanbreaker and the Founder's Edge. Better steel cuts deeper and lasts longer. The Titanbreaker throws slash waves, the Founder's Edge throws lightning.

Blades wear down and shatter. Whetstones and blade packs keep you fighting.
manual.takemtitans.titans.title: Titans
manual.takemtitans.titans.0.title: Pure & Abnormal
manual.takemtitans.titans.0.body:
Pure titans walk straight at you, from three to fifteen metres tall. Abnormals run, leap and crawl and never do what you expect.

At night titans lose their sunlight and grow sluggish.

If one grabs you, hammer [ATTACK] to break free before it bites.
manual.takemtitans.titans.1.title: The Shifters & Giants
manual.takemtitans.titans.1.body:
Armored Titan: plates that crack under heavy hits. Beast Titan: throws boulders from afar. Jaw Titan: fast, and bites. Ravager: a living siege engine. Colossal Titan: steam and heat. Wall Titan: four cores seal its nape, destroy them first.

Thunder spears and cannons do what blades cannot.
manual.takemtitans.squad.title: Squad & Horse
manual.takemtitans.squad.0.title: Your Squad
manual.takemtitans.squad.0.body:
Hire Jaegers at the quartermaster. They level up with every kill and take orders when you talk to them: hold or follow.

A squad member who goes down is carried off the field and rejoins you two minutes later. Left behind, they catch up on their own.
manual.takemtitans.squad.1.title: Your Horse
manual.takemtitans.squad.1.body:
The horse whistle calls your scout horse. At a gallop it builds a charge, leaps higher and bowls small foes over, and it senses titans nearby.

Ride past a titan with blades out and you cut it behind the knee. [DASH] in the saddle throws the horse sideways out of a grab. Fire your hooks from the saddle and the cable lifts you into the air.
manual.takemtitans.city.title: Cities & Ruin
manual.takemtitans.city.0.title: Everything Can Fall
manual.takemtitans.city.0.body:
Buildings carry real weight. Break what holds them up and the floors above come down in pieces, with dust, rubble and rumble.

A hook that strikes a falling chunk while you hold [WINCH] catches it: swing it around and throw it at a titan.
manual.takemtitans.city.1.title: Raids & Rebuilding
manual.takemtitans.city.1.body:
At sunset titans may raid a district: bells, red flares, then waves of them at the wall. Hold the district and you are paid well.

Ruined districts rebuild themselves over time. The quartermaster can fortify a district so it holds better next time.
manual.takemtitans.progress.title: Progress
manual.takemtitans.progress.0.title: Ranks & Skills
manual.takemtitans.progress.0.body:
Kills and missions earn experience. You climb from Trainee to Legend, and every level brings skill points.

[SKILLS] opens the skill tree: faster reels, bigger squads, new moves and masteries.
manual.takemtitans.progress.1.title: After the Story
manual.takemtitans.progress.1.body:
When the Wall Titan falls, the war goes on. Commander Varne hands out contracts: hunts, defences and bounties, as many as you want.

The best gear in the shop is meant for this stretch.
intro.takemtitans.advanced.0: More gas, a harder reel and a stronger dash.
intro.takemtitans.advanced.1: Same controls, just more of everything.
intro.takemtitans.phantom.0: Phase Dash: every [DASH] makes you untouchable for a heartbeat.
intro.takemtitans.godspeed.1: At full speed you break the sound barrier: the boom hurts everything near you and blows out windows.
intro.takemtitans.event_horizon.0: Hyperspace Jump: [BOOST] + [DASH] tears you up to 28 blocks along your view.
intro.takemtitans.event_horizon.1: Titans in the way are cut, everything at the far end is thrown back.
intro.takemtitans.event_horizon.2: Also: Phase Dash and the sonic boom.
message.takemtitans.jaeger_wounded: %s is down and being carried off. Back in two minutes.
message.takemtitans.jaeger_back: %s is back on their feet and rejoins the squad.
advancement.takemtitans.root.desc: Strap on your first ODM gear
advancement.takemtitans.event_horizon.de: Get the Event Horizon ODM Gear
advancement.takemtitans.ravager.desc: Bring down the Ravager before it reaches Mitras
advancement.takemtitans.manual.desc: Get the Survey Corps field manual
tooltip.takemtitans.founder3: Supernova: overcharge a Blade Rush and let go - wherever you look, up to 160 blocks off, the Coordinate gathers and goes off like a dying star: the ground torn open, every titan in reach struck at the nape. One minute to recover.
waystone.takemtitans.title: Waystones of the Walls
waystone.takemtitans.hint: Click a lit waystone to travel there. Grey ones are still asleep: touch them first.
message.takemtitans.waystone_woken: The waystone of %s wakes. You can travel here from any other.
message.takemtitans.waystone_busy: The waystone needs a moment to gather itself.
message.takemtitans.waystone_far: Too far from a waystone to travel.
tooltip.takemtitans.mod.frame: A third more air control, and you fall a little lighter.
tooltip.takemtitans.mod.barbs: A hook that strikes a titan tears it and slows it down.
tooltip.takemtitans.mod.twin_chamber: The dash recharges a third faster.
tooltip.takemtitans.mod_use: Use while wearing ODM gear to fit it. Full rigs swap out their oldest mod.
message.takemtitans.mod_no_gear: Put on your ODM gear first.
message.takemtitans.nape_crystal: Her nape is crystal - wait for it to fade, or crack it with a spear
message.takemtitans.female_scream: She screams - the titans are coming!
message.takemtitans.war_hammer_exposed: The cocoon shatters - the nape is bare!
message.takemtitans.war_hammer_sealed: Nothing in there - follow the cord of light to the crystal cocoon
message.takemtitans.cart_plate_broken: The plate is off - go for the nape!
manual.takemtitans.valgard.title: Valgard & the Waves
manual.takemtitans.valgard.0.title: Waystones & Valgard
manual.takemtitans.valgard.0.body:
Every district has a waystone. Touch one once and it is yours: from then on any waystone carries you to it.

Far south-east of Shiganshina stands Valgard, a sandstone arena city on the open plain, built to be fought in and torn down. Its waystone waits at the south gate.
manual.takemtitans.valgard.1.title: The Bell of Valgard
manual.takemtitans.valgard.1.body:
Ring the bell on the fighting floor and the waves begin: more titans each wave, a shifter at the head of every fifth. From wave three, boulders come over the wall.

Fall or leave the district and the run ends. Afterwards the builders put Valgard back up.
wave.takemtitans.countdown: The bell has rung - the first wave comes in five seconds
wave.takemtitans.title: Wave %s
wave.takemtitans.sub: %s titans are coming up through the streets
wave.takemtitans.come_back: Get back into Valgard or the run is over!
wave.takemtitans.barrage_sub: Valgard is coming apart around you
wave.takemtitans.hint: Ring the bell on the fighting floor to start the waves
night.takemtitans.title: Night Mission
night.takemtitans.sub: Titans are awake in the fog near %s - bring down %s before dawn
night.takemtitans.won: The fog is clear of them
night.takemtitans.lost_sub: %s of %s brought down. The rest are gone into the hills.
manual.takemtitans.city.2.title: Night Missions
manual.takemtitans.city.2.body:
Titans sleep at night - most of them. On some nights word comes that a pack is awake somewhere nearby, and a thick fog rolls in over the place.

Go in, bring down as many as asked before dawn and you are paid well. In the fog a titan is only a shape until it is close: listen for the steps.
wave.takemtitans.resupply: Supply crate: gas and blades refilled
manual.takemtitans.titans.2.title: Shifters & Ghouls
manual.takemtitans.titans.2.body:
The Female Titan floods her nape with crystal when you close in: bait it, wait for the glint to fade, or crack it with a thunder spear. The War Hammer's nape is empty - follow the cord of light to the crystal cocoon behind it. The Cart Titan's plate gives to spears and cannon fire.

Ghouls hunt at night: they come in bursts, freeze, and spring.
shout.takemtitans.talk.0: Did you hear? They say there's a whole city out on the plain, built just for fighting.
shout.takemtitans.talk.2: My cousin swears something white ran past his farm last night. On all fours.
shout.takemtitans.talk.3: The builders had our street back up in a day. A day!
shout.takemtitans.talk.4: One of them screamed and every titan for miles came running. A titan that screams!
shout.takemtitans.talk.5: Don't go out past the wall after dark. Not this week.
shout.takemtitans.talk.6: That Scout flew right over my roof. I nearly dropped the washing.
shout.takemtitans.talk.7: The Garrison drinks more than it guards, if you ask me.
shout.takemtitans.talk.8: They found crystal in the street after the last attack. Crystal!
shout.takemtitans.talk.9: Have you been up the bell tower? You can see Wall Rose from there.
shout.takemtitans.talk.10: The Wall will protect us. The Wall always protects us.
shout.takemtitans.talk.11: My boy wants to join the Survey Corps. Over my dead body.
shout.takemtitans.talk.12: Something with a cannon on its back, they said. Pulling guns like a horse.
shout.takemtitans.talk.13: The fog came in thick over the fields last night. I heard footsteps in it.
shout.takemtitans.talk.14: Prices at the market in Karanes are a robbery.
shout.takemtitans.talk.15: They say a bell in Valgard calls the titans. Who would ring that?
party.takemtitans.invite: %s invites you to their party - type /party accept
party.takemtitans.joined: You joined %s's party. Their story is your story now.
tooltip.takemtitans.shifter_serum: Inject it: lightning strikes, and for 45 seconds you are a sixteen-metre Titan.
tooltip.takemtitans.shifter_serum_contro: Attack strikes (every third blow stomps) - Use roars - Hook key leaps - Hold Sneak to cut yourself free
tooltip.takemtitans.shifter_serum_warnin: Buildings will not survive it. Neither will the Titans.
tooltip.takemtitans.odm_pistols: Two guns, four barrels of buckshot. In the air every shot throws you back; a shot to the eyes blinds a Titan.
tooltip.takemtitans.odm_pistols_volley: Sneak and hold to charge a volley: every barrel at once, incendiary shot.
hud.takemtitans.shift.title: TITAN SHIFT
hud.takemtitans.shift.subtitle: The body is yours for 45 seconds
hud.takemtitans.shift.name: TITAN
